description: Land Title Settlement Department - Illuppugedara, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420280
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining title to specific land parcels (Nos. 162-174) in Kurunegala District, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, and ownership information (all listed as "The State"). The content focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
